AUTHOR: Frandsen
TITLE: Combining Deep Learning and Ecological Monitoring for BRUV Coral Reef Megafauna Assessment
REGION: Gita Nada MPA, Lombok, Indonesia (53 sites)
SPECIES: Six Morphological Groups from 28 focal species: Carangidae, Carcharhinidae, Cheilinus undulatus, Cheloniidae (sea turtles), Myliobatiformes, Sphyraenidae
DATA: Own SORCE mono-BRUV footage: 244 deployments, 328 h, 2023-2025; 7781 annotated frames at 2 fps
V_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'deployments with visibility below 10 m or depths exceeding 15 m were excluded.'; Sec. 2.1: 'at depths varying from 2.5 to 30.3 m'
D2: 80/10/10 semi-randomised at BRUV deployment level (5770/975/1036 frames)
D_EV: Sec. 2.2.2: 'To prevent data leakage ... the split was performed at the BRUV deployment level rather than at the frame level.'
R_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'the temporal sighting tracker demonstrated varying degrees of performance when applied to the video clips from the test dataset.' (held-out deployments, same programme)
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'a confidence threshold of 0.20 was applied'; MaxN 'preventing double-counting of wandering individuals'; validation quantified 'fragmentation of sighting events or undercounting'
E_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'The metrics generated by the pipeline (MaxN, T1st, and Tvisit) were directly compared to manual expert counts'; Table 3 overall MaxN accuracy 0.68
ARCH: YOLOv12x initialised from Community Fish Detector weights + rule-based temporal sighting tracker (5 s gap, conf 0.20)
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP50, mAP50-95; tracker recall/precision; MaxN/T1st/Tvisit accuracy vs expert
NOTE: V1 coded 기타 정량 because visibility (m) was used as an exclusion criterion (<10 m) for the ecological case study only, implying quantitative recording; no performance stratified by visibility -> V_ALL P. P1 not applied: visibility was measured and the restriction applies to the case study, not model training/testing. Split by BRUV deployment (each deployment = one video) -> 영상(video). Held-out deployments within same SORCE programme -> R1 N (P2). C5 coded 중복계수 처리: MaxN explicitly used to avoid double counting and tracker validation quantified sighting fragmentation; human-in-the-loop correction of tracking in case study, but no FP rate from verification sample reported. This C5 judgement drives C_ALL=Y; without it C_ALL would fall in the P/N rule gap (non-default low threshold 0.1/0.2 with rationale and FP discussion). E1 복수: MaxN plus T1st/Tvisit (visit duration framed as behavioural proxy). Comparison only with expert reading of the same footage -> E_ALL P. Includes non-fish taxa (sea turtles) alongside fish groups. Code/materials promised 'where possible' or on request -> CODE N.
